group: q|how many monthly listeners on spotify is top 1% of artists

result.why: No credible source publishes a percentile distribution of Spotify artists by monthly listeners. Spotify's own Loud & Clear material (loudandclear.byspotify.com, plus press coverage of it) gives only threshold counts. The 2023 figures are: about 10 million uploaders (accounts with at least one release); over 12,000 artists with 1 million or more monthly listeners, about 0.1%; and about 225,000 to 288,000 'emerging and professional' artists. That last group is a combined criterion (10+ releases plus an average of 10,000+ monthly listeners, or a show played, depending on the edition), so it cannot be read as a listener threshold. MBW (April 2022), using Spotify's earlier calculator, reported about 1.73 million of roughly 8 million artists with more than 50 monthly listeners, about 21.6%. Together these put the top 0.1% at roughly 1 million monthly listeners, but they do not pin down the top 1% (about 100,000 artists). That cut-off sits somewhere between about 10,000 and 1 million monthly listeners, and no Spotify figure narrows it. The only page that gives a top-1% number is a marketing blog (dynamoi.com), which labels its 1,000 and 100,000 rows as estimates with no data behind them, so it fails the source requirements. Billboard's 2021 'Republic of Spotify' piece reported only a ratio between the 90th and 50th percentiles, and its sample was not the full artist base. Possible fallback: the site could ship p99.9 of about 1,000,000 monthly listeners (Spotify Loud & Clear 2023: 12,000+ of about 10 million uploaders), but that answers a different percentile from the one asked.
